market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal has finished 2nd in the EPL for two consecutive seasons (2022–23 and 2023–24) with a talented, well-coached squad. Their underlying metrics, investment, and stability under Arteta suggest they are likely to contend for the top two again. I estimate the true probability of exactly 2nd place to be around 25%, well above the market's 16.5%, implying positive expected value on 'Yes'.
evidence_points: Arsenal finished 2nd in 2022–23 and 2023–24, trailing only Manchester City.
The squad core (Saka, Ødegaard, Saliba, etc.) is young and improving; Arteta's tactical system is entrenched.
While City remains a strong favorite, Liverpool is in transition, Chelsea and Manchester United are inconsistent, making Arsenal a strong bet for a top-2 finish.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of team strength and managerial situations ahead of 2025–26
Betting odds for EPL outrights in comparable seasons
